node.title: upload to PAUSE didn't seem to trigger tests
node.author: scooter
node.doctext: A few days ago, I uploaded Graphics::Fig v1.0.4 with a fix to a long outstanding bug. The upload seems to have worked. From another computer, I did an install Graphics::Fig from cpan and got the new version. But I didn't receive any emails after the upload with test results. Did the tests happen silently? Or were they not triggered? If the later, what can I do to trigger them?
